title: Işığını Arayan Çocuk
author: Yasemin Meriç Kazdal & Buket Yükseker
description: This is the Land of the Dreams. Here, everything follows the rules. Looking up at the sky, slowing down, and being different are frowned upon. People don't stray from their familiar paths; they walk without thinking. Lori begins to search for her own path in this world. With every step she takes to find her light, she faces voices, fears, and thoughts that try to stop her. Sometimes she walks alone, sometimes with others; she falls, stops, tries again. The road is long, but the sky is still there. This story, which accompanies every child in discovering their inner strength and supports emotional well-being, is the first stop in the “The Land of Dreams” series.
english_title: The Child Searching For The Light
